edges.text: A Bachelor's degree, equivalent to a Swedish Kandidatexamen, from an internationally recognised university. Also required is 45 credits from semesters 1 and 2 of the Master's Programme in Management, Communication and IT. Proficiency in Swedish and English equivalent to the general entry requirements for first-cycle (Bachelor's level) studies.
